apps.name: Stillspace
apps.tagline: Find a little space for yourself.
apps.description: A calm personal wellness app with guided practices for focus, sleep, stress relief and everyday balance.

apps.name: Maverick Utility Lab
apps.description: A growing collection of practical micro-tools and experiments from Code Mavericks.

games.name: Don't Do That
games.tagline: Do the opposite. Pick the wrong answer. Break every rule.
games.description: A fast-paced reverse-logic arcade game where good instincts are bad decisions. Pick the wrong answer, master chaotic game modes, complete daily missions, collect Bomb Crew characters, customise your game and challenge your friends.

games.name: Literally Illiterate
games.tagline: Think you know words? Think again.
games.description: A playful word game packed with vocabulary challenges, story-based gameplay, word puzzles and fast rounds designed to test what you really know.

games.name: Steampunk Chronicles
games.tagline: A world of gears, aether and rebellion.
games.description: A story-rich steampunk RPG with tactical turn-based combat, multiple heroes, capturable beasts and a cinematic adventure.

games.name: Number Outlaw
games.tagline: Quick maths. Big streaks. No mercy.
games.description: An arcade-style number game built around rapid puzzles, score chasing, streaks and increasingly difficult challenges.
